label: DATEDIFF()
note: DATEDIFF(d1,d2) is d1 minus d2 using date parts. TIMESTAMPDIFF(unit,d1,d2) uses d2 minus d1.

uses.title: 197 · Rising temperature
uses.snippet:
FROM Weather w1, Weather w2
WHERE DATEDIFF(w1.recordDate, w2.recordDate) = 1 AND w1.temperature > w2.temperature

uses.title: 1141 · User activity in a 30-day window
uses.snippet:
WHERE
    DATEDIFF('2019-07-27',   activity_date) < 30 AND
    activity_date   <= '2019-07-27'   AND
    activity_type   IN ('open_session', 'end_session', 'scroll_down', 'send_message')
